decisive_diff.changes: Relative missing-template error path, missing-template test check, changelog and version. No dependency changes. Certificate authority, mock proxy and browser bundles byte-identical.
decisive_diff.additional_comparison: 0.31.3 also contains the identical certificate authority. 0.32.0 also fires the original rule under current traits; the earlier-clean queue premise was not reproduced.

execution_trace: trmnlp test loads testing/rspec.rb; Testing.authority lazily creates RSA-2048 key and temporary CA, registering removal at exit.
Run opens MockProxy on 127.0.0.1 at an ephemeral port. CONNECT negotiates a generated hostname certificate and answers through MockTable; unmatched requests get 599.

Proxy environment adds Node, Python, Ruby, PHP trust settings to the transform subprocess environment; Open3.popen3 receives that map. No parent-wide environment mutation or system trust-store writes.
Certificate bundle reads the system trust file and writes only a temporary concatenated bundle; the CA private key remains in memory.

Main preview code watches plugin templates, serves rendered views, performs configured polling and local transform execution, and stores ordinary OAuth sessions. Minified picker uses esbuild helpers, DOM and browser storage.

Gem has no native extension install hooks. Decoded-string facts for CA and both browser scripts contained only RawScan strings; inspection found ordinary source and bundling rather than concealed payloads.
limitations: Deployment context is unavailable. Static execution-path analysis supports intended developer/test use; sample runtime requires Ruby >= 4.0, while the available Ruby is 2.6, so the gem was not executed.
Scanner warns its model feature specification is v18 while extractor expects v19; classifier results are reported without treating probabilities as behavioral proof.
other_changes: Removed arbitrary session.rb basename as a Net::SSH fingerprint; session identity now needs namespace, channel import and Net::SSH.start evidence.
Added numeric OpenSSL RSA generation observation; extended Ruby popen call matching to popen2 and popen3.

Preserved existing agent-skill directory exclusion populations by referencing the two relocated wording observations explicitly. New certificate-extension leaf avoids expanding the credential-export exemption on certificate/usage.

coverage_validation.improved_attack: A reverse shell named session.rb now also fires the hostile fd-redirection composite, which the former basename fingerprint exempted.
coverage_validation.real_positive_outside_batch: Net::SSH 7.3.2 connection/session.rb from the separate extracted Metasploit package retains all four content-based identity observations; only its unsupported basename identity is removed.

classifier.judgement_agreement: Both calibrated classifier verdicts are BENIGN (cls 0; level -1). No remaining verdict disagreement.
